title: Half-term hifdh check: An-Naba' against the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: An-Naba' and Al-Qadr as a model
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 46 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 46. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا (٣٧) يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا (٣٨) ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا (٣٩) إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا (٤٠)

questions.q: Hifdh check: today's group recites An-Naba' to the teacher against the rubric. Everyone else: manzil rota and targets in the log.
Extend: recite 'Abasa 1 to 16 from the manzil rota.
Think again: Juz' 'Amma is now almost complete. What will help you keep 37 surahs for life?
questions.a: A manzil rota, reciting in salah, and teaching younger siblings.
